attchmntText: Anik Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Anik Industries Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board took note of the Statutory Auditor’s Limited Review Report. Standalone net profit for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 16.18 Lakhs rupees, compared to 74.82 Lakhs rupees in the previous year. Standalone net profit for the half year ended 30th September 2026 was 124.39 Lakhs rupees, compared to 129.04 Lakhs rupees in the previous year. Consolidated results include the subsidiary Revera Milk and Foods Private Limited. The auditor reported no material misstatements in the financial results. The Board meeting was held on 14th November 2026.
